summary: British American Tobacco p.l.c. filed a Form 6-K on August 6, 2026, disclosing management board changes. Chief Marketing Officer Luciano Comin will step down on February 28, 2027, after 34 years with the group. Pascale Meulemeester, currently Regional Director APMEA, will succeed him, becoming CMO Designate on January 1, 2027, and CMO on March 1, 2027. Celina Li will join as Regional Director Designate APMEA on September 1, 2026, and assume the role on January 1, 2027. These are planned, orderly transitions, not abrupt departures. Watch for further leadership announcements or strategic impacts related to brand transformation.
